caption: Welcome to the product
text: Welcome. In this short tutorial, I'll walk you through the feature end to end — what it does, how to set it up, and how to use it day to day.

caption: What you're looking at
text: This is the main workspace. Everything you create shows up here, with its current status right alongside it.

caption: Create your first project
text: Click New project, give it a name, and choose a region close to your users.
